mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get started with Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on your chosen go-live date. Our team provides a dedicated onboarding period, handling data migration, setup, and training to get your clinic fully operational with minimal disruption.

mainEntity.name: Will there be downtime during implementation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Clinics stay operational while we handle setup in the background. There’s no disruption to your patient flow or revenue cycle.

mainEntity.name: How easy is it to train my team on Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt is designed to be intuitive. We provide dedicated onboarding, video tutorials, and training sessions with your success manager to answer questions, build confidence, and get started with ease.

mainEntity.name: Is Prompt’s support really as good as people say?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our U.S.-based support team includes experts in billing, clinical workflows, and EDI. We don’t offshore or route you to bots. You’ll talk to real people who understand your practice.

mainEntity.name: Can I speak with someone to see if Prompt is the right fit for my clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Schedule a demo or ask for a real customer reference to better understand how Prompt works in practices like yours. We’re happy to connect you.
Prompt offers transparent, flat-rate pricing. No hidden fees for features like reminders, digital intake, or HEP. What you see is what you pay.

mainEntity.name: How does Prompt’s pricing compare to other systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt is designed to deliver more value out of the box. While some platforms offer a lower base price, they often charge extra for essentials like AI note drafting, claim scrubbing, billing tools, and reporting. With Prompt, those capabilities come standard, so clinics often see stronger ROI through faster documentation, cleaner claims, and fewer cancellations. Many practices find that Prompt ultimately costs less when you factor in the time, tools, and results.

mainEntity.name: Does Prompt have built-in billing tools and optional RCM services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Prompt includes a natively built RCM platform with real-time claim tracking, payer rule alerts, and integrated 2-way clearinghouse connection. No add-ons required. Clinics can also choose Prompt’s RCM services as needed.

mainEntity.name: What kind of AI* capabilities does Prompt offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt’s AI* supports real-time documentation, CPT coding, and workflows. Unlike other platforms, it’s built for accuracy, efficiency, and compliance, not just automation for the sake of it.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my templates and workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Completely. From evals and notes to automations and dashboards, Prompt gives you full control without sacrificing compliance.

mainEntity.name: Is Prompt right for my size clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt is built to scale, from solo providers to multi-location practices. Whether you’re just starting out or growing fast, we’ll grow with you.

mainEntity.name: What should I consider if I’m still evaluating options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comparing systems takes time and most clinics want to feel confident before making a decision. We’re happy to help you evaluate whether Prompt aligns with your goals and workflows.
